description: Six original raw magical identities; owner choice pending.

directions.name: Coal & Salt
directions.style_block: Ragged soot-black brush contours, broken dry-brush fills and chalk-salt highlights. Strong two-value masses, rough cross-strokes only at silhouette edges; quiet broad ground. Hooded cloth silhouettes lean forward, hooked hoods, asymmetrical knotted belts and split hems. Ash umber and muted slate ground; salt ivory cloth, dull bronze hardware, restrained elemental accents. Staffs look like charred forked timber with hammered bindings. Enemies have rough slab shields and blunt black silhouettes; wardstones are chipped, tar-dark uprights. Raw confident martial drawing, never decorative papyrus. For the portrait, keep rugged ink edges beneath dense opaque oil-like face painting, dramatic light and shadow, rich dark background, chipped bronze frame.

directions.name: Cinder Veil
directions.silhouette: heavy cowls and long split mantles
directions.style_block: Dark smoky oil painting with visible hog-bristle marks, thick scraped impasto on lit cloth and lost-and-found shadow edges; no uniform outline. Great pale cowls and long split mantles form weighted triangular silhouettes with bent knees. Coal plum, burnt umber and warm ash dominate; bone-white cloth and small saturated elemental light puncture the darkness. Equipment is battered blackened bronze, heat-clouded glass and charred wood. Enemies are weighty smoky forms with hard lit weapon edges; wardstones are slag-like stone with luminous cracks. Ground is a low-detail dark ash field rubbed with soot. The portrait is layered dark oil, intensely lit weathered face, visible brush ridges, water glow in the shadows and an ornate blackened metal frame.

directions.name: Flint Litany
directions.silhouette: sawtooth shoulder wraps and triangular hems
directions.style_block: Hand-painted opaque gouache with palette-knife chips, angular broken edges and three hard interlocking value planes; no smooth airbrush or rounded cartoon contour. Sharp folded shoulder wraps, diagonal sashes and triangular ragged hems make striking faceted upright silhouettes. Basalt grey, dirty ochre and dusty violet ground; warm ivory cloth, slate-blue shadow planes, hammered copper plus restrained elemental accents. Staff heads are asymmetric split mineral prisms bound to rough wood. Enemies carry angular dented shields; low wedge wardstones and jagged geometric rune cuts break the sand. Ground is broad low-detail matte mineral paint. Portrait stays richly painted and volumetric through decisive faceted brush planes, strong side light, dark background and a chipped carved mineral-and-copper frame.

directions.name: Verdigris Covenant
directions.shading: transparent umber glazes over dark hatch
directions.silhouette: narrow tall cowls and crescent shoulder folds
directions.style_block: Frayed copperplate-like etched strokes under translucent umber and malachite paint glazes, broken hatch in shadow only, broad luminous cloth shapes left simple. Narrow tall cowls, crescent shoulder folds and trailing cord bundles form wiry silhouettes. Deep bottle-green, near-black umber and muted copper ground; pale linen, oxidized bronze fasteners and restrained elemental accents. Staffs are weathered spiral timber with corroded metal cages and cloudy glass. Enemies carry pitted scale pieces and buckled round shields; wardstones are eroded spiral stone with green oxidation in recesses. The ground has sparse etched cracks, not a sheet of parchment. Portrait is dark translucent oil painting with luminous painted skin, fine etched wear in accessories, water reflections and an ornate corroded copper frame.

directions.name: Ragged Oracle
directions.line: torn painted edges and charcoal seams
directions.shading: layered opaque pigment with coarse fibre
directions.silhouette: offset wrapped cowls and pennant-like split cloth
directions.style_block: Painted mixed-media language: irregular torn pigment edges, charcoal seams, coarse fibre impressions and overlapping patched colour masses, all fused into a spatially convincing painted world. Offset wrapped cowls, diagonal stitched straps and pennant-like split cloth make asymmetric silhouettes. Dirty indigo, clay brown and soot form the ground; faded cream and pale coloured cloth with sparse warm brass, elemental accents kept small. Staffs are crooked driftwood bound with frayed textile and bead talismans. Enemies use laced battered shields and patched metal; wardstones are wrapped, cracked pillars with ragged hanging cords. Ground is quiet rubbed pigment with a few sewn-looking fissures, never a flat scrapbook. Portrait is a rich dark painted face, not a collage face: tactile pigment, uneven brush marks, water mist, layered worn fabric and an ornate stitched-leather-and-tarnished-brass frame.

directions.name: Moonchalk Tempest
directions.line: smudged charcoal and jagged chalk strokes
directions.shading: velvet dark masses with powdery highlights
directions.silhouette: wind-bent long cowls and broad bell sleeves
directions.style_block: Smudged charcoal and thick chalk-pastel strokes over velvety blue-black paint. Deep simple shadow masses, powdery scumbled highlights and jagged luminous edges, visible hand pressure; no glossy neon gradients. Wind-bent long cowls, broad bell sleeves and thin streaming cords create sweeping readable silhouettes. Storm indigo and cold charcoal ground, grey-lilac shadows, pale linen and salt-white cloth with disciplined elemental accents. Staffs are pale lightning-split wood with dull silver wire. Enemies are compact dark masses with chalk-lit crests and weapon edges; wardstones are black monoliths with fractured pale glyphs. Ground is rubbed charcoal sand with localized chalk scuffs. Portrait is a dark richly painted bust with charcoal underdrawing, forceful cool side light, warm human skin, water vapour and a worn silver-and-black-stone ornamental frame.

skeletons.arena:
EXTREME LONG SHOT, HIGH AERIAL VIEW. Landscape arena floor fills the entire 16:9 image. Camera 55 degrees above ground. Tiny upright people with hood tops visible, each whole person 6% of image height (43 pixels at 720p). Distant people are tiny specks on a huge map: no facial or anatomy details. Vast empty floor between every person. No large or foreground person. Enormous open sand-and-ash oval, only distant boundary fragment at the top; floor continues beyond three edges. Environment dominates, miniature people are accents.
Four tiny battle mages scattered widely: pale warm Fire with embers/heat shimmer; pale-blue hooded Water Cassia with mist/droplets; pale-ochre Earth with stone motes/dust; pale-lilac Air with wind wisps/lightning. Worn light layered cloth, staffs, equipment, local elemental sparkles, braced casts. Dark foot edges and small contact shadows integrate bodies. Three tiny enemy types above: legion shield soldiers, ember hounds, squat thorn-backed stone creature. Cyan bolt and little forward open crescent at Cassia. Cracked quiet sand, five distant wardstone pylons, rune glyphs, scorch and elemental residue. All intact; no gore or injury. Original hand-painted digital 2D gameplay view, no 3D/photo, UI, text or logos.
DIRECTION BLOCK:
{DIRECTION}
The above direction is painted at EXTREME LONG SHOT scale: tiny people, vast ground. Never zoom in to show costume detail.
skeletons.portrait:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE richly painted late-1990s computer role-playing bust portrait of Cassia, the adult Water battle mage. A single vertical ornate worn frame occupies the middle of a 16:9 dark painted field; no second portrait or panel. Bust from upper chest upward, face large and legible inside the frame. Three-quarter head turned slightly left, gaze toward viewer, forceful side light, deep shadow on the other cheek, quiet dark backdrop.
DIRECTION BLOCK:
{DIRECTION}
FIXED CHARACTER: Cassia is an adult woman in her late thirties, olive skin, dark wavy hair with a few silver strands, strong long nose, asymmetrical brows, deep-set grey-blue eyes, broad cheekbones, weathered tired skin and a steady defiant expression. Characterful believable face, neither idealised doll nor glamorous fashion model. No facial injury. A loose worn deep-blue hood sits back from the face above pale blue and ivory layered cloth, practical crossed straps, tarnished bronze fasteners, a small cloudy-glass water talisman, and the edge of her equipped staff beside one shoulder. She is a field magician, not a civic official.
FIXED MOOD AND LIGHT: rich dark painterly bust, saturated blue-green reflected water light under the warm lit face, small suspended droplets, thin water vapour and subtle wave-shaped energy behind her shoulder. Brush marks build volume and lived character. Ornate frame has visible rubbed corners, tarnish, chips and invented tidal ornament; it feels old and handled. Strong portrait mood, deep colour, clear face, elemental aura. Frame and costume follow the direction; the face remains richly PAINTED in every direction. No flat mural face or parchment.
Original designs only. Hand-drawn digital 2D concept art with visible imperfect marks, wear and material history. Raw, forceful, fantastical magic. Roman-inspired arena culture is a distant worldbuilding base, not a museum illustration. No gore, wounds, corpses, dismemberment or injury depiction. No photographic or 3D rendering, polished generic fantasy finish, clean vector contours, readable text, labels, logo or watermark. No copied characters. Invented abstract rune glyphs are allowed. Use the SAME direction language for people, equipment, creatures and architecture. This is a complete artwork, not a character sheet or multipanel grid.

revision_reason: Coal arena capped after three camera rejects. New Cinder arena pilot; same compact arena skeleton across all remaining directions, old prompts retained.
